text: {"lessons":["Repeatedly switching positions without a clear, evidence-based reason can add risk without improving returns; define what would change my view before trading.","Selling a losing position or taking profits should depend on its prospects and portfolio role, not on the discomfort of a loss or the desire to lock in a gain.","My account’s modest rise over ten periods does not show that I beat the market; compare results with a suitable benchmark across longer periods and full market cycles."]}
